request_text: Evaluate and govern a canonical documentation update after completion of the SP500 history gap fix and the remaining Layer-2 TODO items. The requested outcome is a documentation update plan and verification deltas that align the canonical current-state documents with the implemented Layer-2 state. Do not claim that Layer-3 is implemented. Do not claim live execution readiness. Preserve Layer-2 / Layer-3 canonical terminology. Treat this as a documentation synchronization and verification request, not a semantic rename or constitutional amendment.

scope.primary_goal: Update canonical documents to reflect implemented Layer-2 changes.
disallowed_outputs_or_actions: Do not directly edit canonical markdown files from this request.
Do not rename Layer 2 or Layer 3.
Do not introduce truth_store or decision_layer terminology.
Do not mark Layer-3 implementation as built.
Do not mark live execution, trading, order generation, or execution orchestration as available.
Do not treat documentation-only evidence as proof of runtime behavior.

Existing FRED SP500 remains unchanged and is not replaced.
SP500_PROXY is included in snapshots through registry-driven inclusion.
The registry_version was incremented to reflect the new series configuration.
The SPY adapter/backfill path is idempotent and uses INSERT OR IGNORE semantics.
Quality gate and snapshot dry-run should account for SP500_PROXY as a Tier-1 snapshot-included series if the registry marks it as such.

expected_evidence: SPY adapter exists or equivalent ingestion path exists
source/provenance is distinct from FRED SP500

expected_evidence: snapshot_publisher reuses aligned payload and does not hardcode series
